name: prueba-accenture
description: Prueba tecnica Accenture - franquicias. Angular 22 + Spring WebFlux + PostgreSQL 18 sobre nginx.

scripts.restart: bun run down && bun run up
scripts.rebuild:backend: docker compose -p prueba-accenture --env-file .env -f infra/docker/compose.yml up -d --build backend
scripts.rebuild:frontend: docker compose -p prueba-accenture --env-file .env -f infra/docker/compose.yml up -d --build frontend
scripts.db:shell: docker compose -p prueba-accenture --env-file .env -f infra/docker/compose.yml exec postgres psql -U franchises -d franchises
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -p prueba-accenture --env-file .env -f infra/docker/compose.yml down -v && bun run up
